ideas.question: How does maternal prepregnancy body mass index (BMI) relate to sudden unexpected infant death (SUID) compared to other causes of infant death?
ideas.comparison: Cases: Sudden unexpected infant death (SUID); comparison group: Other causes of infant death recorded in the same case series. Years needed: 2008-2019.
ideas.why_open: Maternal obesity is a known risk factor for SUID, but its role compared to other types of infant deaths remains unclear and needs further investigation to inform specific prevention strategies.
ideas.data: Use D56 ncfrp_v51 / Maternal Weight and Care to measure maternal prepregnancy BMI for SUID cases, compare with other infant deaths using same domain. Use D287 prams_p8_arf / Medical Conditions or D287 prams_p7_arf / Medical Conditions for prevalence of obesity among mothers in the reference population.
